candidates.description: This vector represents common Thai auxiliary verbs, modal verbs, and pronouns used to indicate future action, possibility, or obligation.
This vector represents Thai script tokens frequently featuring the consonant 'ต' (to tao).
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant 'ม' (Mo Ma) and its common positional forms and syllable combinations.
These tokens represent common Thai consonantal characters and syllable initial letters used in the Thai writing system.
This feature vector represents Thai vowel markers, tone marks, and consonant clusters associated with the Thai script.
This feature vector represents common Thai syllable prefixes, word beginnings, and character combinations.
This vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ว' (wo waen) combined with various preceding vowels and tonal marks.
These tokens represent common Thai words, prefixes, and syllable fragments found in everyday digital communication and text processing.
This feature vector represents names of prominent newspapers and news publications across multiple languages.
This feature activates for terms and subword tokens related to the Thai language and Southeast Asian script.
